standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: yawn* I told you human, I'm not interested in following your Saradomin.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: Oh, you're a different human than last time. Well, Marimbo is the only goddess for me and you won't persuade me otherwise.

standard-dialogue.player: You don't have to worry, I'm not a priest. I won't try to convert you to Saradomin.
Although, I'm not all that familiar with Marimbo. Is that the god you worship?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: Goddess, but yes. All monkeys send their thoughts and prayers to Marimbo.

standard-dialogue.player: I didn't realise monkeys were so religious. You learn something new every day I suppose!

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: Well, if you could start learning how to open this cage that would be appreciated. I've got a job to do.

standard-dialogue.player: Oh, sure... I'll get right on it. But it might take me a while to figure it out.

using-aereck-s-caged-monkey-on-an-affect.text: There is already a monkey in that cage!
